thesis: Semantically identical outcomes can carry inconsistent prices across dates, outcomes, or venues.
universe: binary event contracts on Polymarket and Kalshi; exclude asset-price bets
trigger: The scan flags cross-venue gaps, strike or date ladders, or events of unknown exclusivity.
entry_rule: Verify equivalent rules and settlement sources literally. Account for each leg, fees, depth, and non-atomic execution. Never call a textual match arbitrage.
exit_rule: Official settlement, price invalidation, target, or stated horizon; up to one year.
sizing_hints: Buy YES or NO with cash. Half Kelly with driver and position caps. No naked shorts.
